name: lieutenant-fizz
description: Lieutenant Fizz: a Keen-style platformer series on a Rust/WASM + Three.js engine

scripts.dev: bun run build:wasm && bun run --cwd episodes/episode-1 dev
scripts.build: bun run build:wasm && bun run --cwd episodes/episode-1 build
scripts.check:app-rust: cd apps/player/src-tauri && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine --noEmit && tsc -p episodes/episode-1 --noEmit && tsc -p apps/player --noEmit && tsc -p scripts --noEmit && tsc -p e2e --noEmit
scripts.validate: bun run check:headers && bun run check:font && bun run check:hero && bun run check:sprites && bun run check:social && bun run check:icons && bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run lint:rust && bun run test:rust && bun run build
